name: How long does it take to repair a sticking sliding glass door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a sticking sliding glass door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most sticking sliding glass door repairs can be completed within a few hours, depending on the complexity of the issue. Simple repairs like cleaning and lubricating tracks or replacing a few rollers are generally quick. More extensive damage, such as a severely bent track or multiple component replacements, might take longer. We aim to complete repairs efficiently to minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most repairs take a few hours, but complex issues with tracks or multiple components may take longer. We aim for efficient service.
